method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS. Four engraved meridians and two engraved parallels were read directly and their eight crossings were measured individually. The large western blank-water area was retained as useful clean graticule evidence; linen folds, the magnetic-variation line, shoreline, brooks, geological boundaries and the frame were excluded before corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 61d10mW, 61d05mW, 61d00mW and 60d55mW from west to east. The left labels read 46d45mN and 46d40mN from north to south. The full-resolution contact sheet visibly separates the thin rules from a fold beside the western meridian and from a brook at the south-east crossing; the other intersections lie on clean paper or geological colour.
